d: Rohit Sharma gave Mumbai Indians five IPL titles, lost the captaincy and could now be the man they turn to once again. Rohit Sharma's possible return as MI captain after Hardik Pandya trade could be a story of legacy, unfinished business and a franchise looking to rediscover its winning identity. Rupha Ramani looks at why Mumbai may need its most successful captain again, and whether Rohit can lead MI to one more revival.
